sentences.en: Translator: Joseph Geni Reviewer: Morton Bast (Breathes in)
sentences.zh: 译者：Joseph Geni 审稿人：Morton Bast（吸气）

sentences.en: (Breathes out) So, I didn't always make my living from music.
sentences.zh: （呼气）所以，我并不总是靠音乐谋生。

sentences.en: For about the five years after graduating from an upstanding liberal arts university, this was my day job.
sentences.zh: 从一所优秀的文科大学毕业后的大约五年里，这是我的日常工作。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I was a self-employed living statue called the Eight-Foot Bride, and I love telling people I did this for a job, because everybody always wants to know, who are these freaks in real life.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我是一个个体经营的活生生的雕像，叫做“八英尺新娘”，我喜欢告诉人们我这样做是为了一份工作，因为每个人总是想知道，现实生活中这些怪胎是谁。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Hello. I painted myself white one day, stood on a box, put a hat or a can at my feet, and when someone came by and dropped in money, I handed them a flower --
sentences.zh: （笑声） 你好。有一天，我把自己涂成白色，站在一个盒子上，把一顶帽子或一个罐子放在脚边，当有人过来投钱时，我递给他们一朵花——

sentences.en: and some intense eye contact. And if they didn't take the flower, I threw in a gesture of sadness and longing -- as they walked away.
sentences.zh: 以及一些激烈的目光接触。如果他们不接受这朵花，当他们走开时，我会做出悲伤和渴望的姿态。

sentences.en: (Laughter) So I had the most profound encounters with people, especially lonely people who looked like they hadn't talked to anyone in weeks,
sentences.zh: （笑声）所以我和人们有过最深刻的接触，尤其是那些看起来几周没有和任何人说话的孤独的人，

sentences.en: and we would get this beautiful moment of prolonged eye contact being allowed in a city street, and we would sort of fall in love a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我们会在城市街道上享受长时间目光接触的美好时刻，我们会有点坠入爱河。

sentences.en: And my eyes would say -- "Thank you. I see you."
sentences.zh: 我的眼睛会说——“谢谢你。我看到你了。”

sentences.en: And their eyes would say -- "Nobody ever sees me.
sentences.zh: 他们的眼睛会说——“没有人见过我。

sentences.en: Thank you." I would get harassed sometimes.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。”我有时会受到骚扰。

sentences.en: People would yell at me from their cars.
sentences.zh: 人们会在车里对我大喊大叫。

sentences.en: "Get a job!" (Laughing) And I'd be, like, "This is my job."
sentences.zh: “找份工作吧！” （笑）我会说，“这是我的工作。”

sentences.en: But it hurt, because it made me fear that I was somehow doing something un-joblike and unfair, shameful.
sentences.zh: 但这很伤人，因为这让我担心自己做了一些与工作不符、不公平、可耻的事情。

sentences.en: I had no idea how perfect a real education I was getting for the music business on this box.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我在这个盒子上得到了多么完美的音乐行业真正的教育。

sentences.en: And for the economists out there, you may be interested to know I actually made a pretty predictable income, which was shocking to me, given I had no regular customers, but pretty much 60 bucks on a Tuesday, 90 bucks on a Friday.
sentences.zh: 对于经济学家来说，你可能有兴趣知道我实际上获得了相当可预测的收入，这让我感到震惊，因为我没有固定客户，但周二大约 60 美元，周五 90 美元。

sentences.en: It was consistent. And meanwhile, I was touring locally and playing in nightclubs with my band, the Dresden Dolls.
sentences.zh: 这是一致的。与此同时，我正在当地巡演，并与我的乐队德累斯顿娃娃一起在夜总会演出。

sentences.en: This was me on piano, a genius drummer. I wrote the songs, and eventually we started making enough money that I could quit being a statue, and as we started touring, I really didn't want to lose this sense
sentences.zh: 这就是弹钢琴的我，一个天才鼓手。我写了这些歌曲，最终我们开始赚到足够的钱，我可以不再做一座雕像了，当我们开始巡演时，我真的不想失去这种感觉

sentences.en: of direct connection with people, because I loved it.
sentences.zh: 与人直接联系，因为我喜欢它。

sentences.en: So after all of our shows, we would sign autographs and hug fans and hang out and talk to people, and we made an art out of asking people to help us and join us,
sentences.zh: 所以在我们所有的演出结束后，我们会签名、拥抱粉丝、出去玩、与人们交谈，我们通过请求人们帮助我们并加入我们来创造一门艺术，

sentences.en: and I would track down local musicians and artists and they would set up outside of our shows, and they would pass the hat, and then they would come in and join us onstage, so we had this rotating smorgasbord of weird, random circus guests.
sentences.zh: 我会找到当地的音乐家和艺术家，他们会在我们的演出之外布置，他们会递上帽子，然后他们会进来和我们一起上台，所以我们就有了这个由奇怪的、随机的马戏团客人轮流组成的大杂烩。

sentences.en: And then Twitter came along, and made things even more magic, because I could ask instantly for anything anywhere.
sentences.zh: 然后 Twitter 出现了，让事情变得更加神奇，因为我可以在任何地方立即提出任何要求。

sentences.en: So I would need a piano to practice on, and an hour later I would be at a fan's house.
sentences.zh: 所以我需要一架钢琴来练习，一个小时后我就会到一个歌迷家里。

sentences.en: This is in London. People would bring home-cooked food to us all over the world backstage and feed us and eat with us.
sentences.zh: 这是在伦敦。人们会在后台给我们带来世界各地的家常饭菜，喂我们吃，和我们一起吃饭。

sentences.en: This is in Seattle. Fans who worked in museums and stores and any kind of public space would wave their hands if I would decide to do a last-minute, spontaneous, free gig.
sentences.zh: 这是在西雅图。如果我决定在最后一刻进行一场自发的免费演出，在博物馆、商店和任何公共场所工作的粉丝都会挥手。

sentences.en: This is a library in Auckland. On Saturday I tweeted for this crate and hat, because I did not want to schlep them from the East Coast, and they showed up care of this dude, Chris, from Newport Beach,
sentences.zh: 这是奥克兰的一个图书馆。周六，我在推特上发布了这个板条箱和帽子，因为我不想把它们从东海岸运来，而他们却照顾了这个来自纽波特海滩的家伙克里斯，

sentences.en: who says hello. I once tweeted, "Where in Melbourne can I buy a neti pot?"
sentences.zh: 谁打招呼。我曾经发推文说：“墨尔本哪里可以买到洗鼻壶？”

sentences.en: And a nurse from a hospital drove one right at that moment to the cafe I was in, and I bought her a smoothie and we sat there talking about nursing and death.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，医院的一名护士开着一辆汽车来到我所在的咖啡馆，我给她买了一杯冰沙，我们坐在那里谈论护理和死亡。

sentences.en: And I love this kind of random closeness, which is lucky, because I do a lot of couchsurfing.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这种随机的亲密关系，这很幸运，因为我经常沙发冲浪。

sentences.en: In mansions where everyone in my crew gets their own room but there's no wireless, and in punk squats, everyone on the floor in one room with no toilets but with wireless, clearly making it the better option.
sentences.zh: 在豪宅中，我的团队中的每个人都有自己的房间，但没有无线网络，而在朋克蹲下，每个人都在一个房间的地板上，没有厕所，但有无线网络，显然这是更好的选择。

sentences.en: (Laughter) My crew once pulled our van up to a really poor Miami neighborhood and we found out that our couchsurfing host for the night was an 18-year-old girl, still living at home,
sentences.zh: （笑声）有一次，我的工作人员把我们的货车停到了迈阿密一个非常贫穷的社区，我们发现当晚的沙发客主人是一个 18 岁的女孩，仍然住在家里，

sentences.en: and her family were all undocumented immigrants from Honduras.
sentences.zh: 她和她的家人都是来自洪都拉斯的无证移民。

sentences.en: And that night, her whole family took the couches and she slept together with her mom so that we could take their beds.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她全家人都睡了沙发，她和她妈妈睡在一起，这样我们就可以睡他们的床了。

sentences.en: And I lay there thinking, these people have so little.
sentences.zh: 我躺在那里想，这些人拥有的太少了。

sentences.en: Is this fair? And in the morning, her mom taught us how to try to make tortillas and wanted to give me a Bible, and she took me aside and she said to me in her broken English,
sentences.zh: 这公平吗？早上，她妈妈教我们如何尝试做玉米饼，并想给我一本圣经，她把我拉到一边，用蹩脚的英语对我说，

sentences.en: "Your music has helped my daughter so much.
sentences.zh: “你的音乐对我女儿帮助很大。

sentences.en: Thank you for staying here. We're all so grateful."
sentences.zh: 感谢您留在这里。我们都很感激。”

sentences.en: And I thought, this is fair. This is this.
sentences.zh: 我想，这很公平。这是这个。

sentences.en: A couple of months later, I was in Manhattan, and I tweeted for a crash pad, and at midnight, I'm on the Lower East Side, and it occurs to me I've never actually done this alone.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，我在曼哈顿，我在推特上发布了一个缓冲垫，午夜时分，我在下东区，我突然意识到我从来没有真正独自完成过这件事。

sentences.en: I've always been with my band or my crew.
sentences.zh: 我一直和我的乐队或工作人员在一起。

sentences.en: Is this what stupid people do? (Laughter) Is this how stupid people die?
sentences.zh: 这是愚蠢的人所做的事吗？ （笑声）愚蠢的人就是这样死的吗？

sentences.en: And before I can change my mind, the door busts open.
sentences.zh: 在我改变主意之前，门突然打开了。

sentences.en: She's an artist. He's a financial blogger for Reuters, and they're pouring me a glass of red wine and offering me a bath, and I have had thousands of nights like that and like that.
sentences.zh: 她是一位艺术家。他是路透社的财经博主，他们给我倒了一杯红酒，让我洗澡，我已经度过了数千个这样的夜晚。

sentences.en: So I couchsurf a lot. I also crowdsurf a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以我经常沙发冲浪。我也经常进行人群冲浪。

sentences.en: I maintain couchsurfing and crowdsurfing are basically the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我认为沙发冲浪和人群冲浪基本上是同一件事。

sentences.en: You're falling into the audience and you're trusting each other.
sentences.zh: 你们融入了观众之中，并且彼此信任。

sentences.en: I once asked an opening band of mine if they wanted to go out into the crowd and pass the hat to get some extra money, something that I did a lot.
sentences.zh: 我曾经问过我的一支开场乐队，他们是否愿意走到人群中并传递帽子来获得一些额外的钱，我经常这样做。

sentences.en: And as usual, the band was psyched, but there was this one guy in the band who told me he just couldn't bring himself to go out there.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样，乐队很兴奋，但乐队中有一个人告诉我，他就是无法让自己走出去。

sentences.en: It felt too much like begging to stand there with the hat.
sentences.zh: 这感觉太像乞求戴着帽子站在那里了。

sentences.en: And I recognized his fear of "Is this fair?"
sentences.zh: 我认识到他对“这公平吗？”的恐惧。

sentences.en: and "Get a job." And meanwhile, my band is becoming bigger and bigger.
sentences.zh: 和"找份工作。" 同时,我的乐队 越来越大。

sentences.en: We sign with a major label. And our music is a cross between punk and cabaret.
sentences.zh: 我们的音乐是朋克和卡巴莱的十字架

sentences.en: It's not for everybody. Well, maybe it's for you.
sentences.zh: 不是给每个人的 也许是为了你

sentences.en: (Laughter) We sign, and there's all this hype leading up to our next record.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 我们签了字, 和所有的这些杂音 导致我们的下一个记录。

sentences.en: And it comes out and it sells about 25,000 copies in the first few weeks, and the label considers this a failure.
sentences.zh: 它在最初几周里 销售了大约25,000份, 标签认为这是一个失败。

sentences.en: I was like, "25,000, isn't that a lot?" They said, "No, the sales are going down.
sentences.zh: 我当时想,"2万5,是不是很多?" 他们说,"不,销售量下降。

sentences.en: It's a failure." And they walk off. Right at this same time, I'm signing and hugging after a gig, and a guy comes up to me and hands me a $10 bill, and he says,
sentences.zh: 失败了" 然后他们走了 此时此刻 我签了个字 拥抱演出

sentences.en: "I'm sorry, I burned your CD from a friend."
sentences.zh: "对不起,我烧了你的CD 从一个朋友。"

sentences.en: (Laughter) "But I read your blog, I know you hate your label.
sentences.zh: "但我读了你的博客 我知道你讨厌你的标签"

sentences.en: I just want you to have this money." And this starts happening all the time.
sentences.zh: 我只是想让你有这笔钱。" 这一切开始 发生所有的时间。

sentences.en: I become the hat after my own gigs, but I have to physically stand there and take the help from people, and unlike the guy in the opening band, I've actually had a lot of practice standing there.
sentences.zh: 但我得站在那里 接受别人的帮助 不像开场乐队里的人 我实际上在那里有很多练习

sentences.en: Thank you. And this is the moment I decide I'm just going to give away my music for free online whenever possible, so it's like Metallica over here, Napster, bad; Amanda Palmer over here,
sentences.zh: 谢谢 此时此刻我决定 尽可能免费在网上播放音乐

sentences.en: and I'm going to encourage torrenting, downloading, sharing, but I'm going to ask for help, because I saw it work on the street.
sentences.zh: 我会鼓励播种 下载 分享 但我会请求帮助 因为我看到它在街上工作

sentences.en: So I fought my way off my label, and for my next project with my new band, the Grand Theft Orchestra, I turned to crowdfunding.
sentences.zh: 于是我打破了我的标签, 和我的下一个项目 与我的新乐队, 大盗窃管弦乐队, 我转向人群筹资。

sentences.en: And I fell into those thousands of connections that I'd made, and I asked my crowd to catch me.
sentences.zh: 我陷入了成千上万的连接, 我让观众抓住我。

sentences.en: And the goal was 100,000 dollars. My fans backed me at nearly 1.2 million, which was the biggest music crowdfunding project to date.
sentences.zh: 目标是10万美元。我的粉丝支持我120万, 这是迄今为止最大的音乐集资项目。

sentences.en: (Applause) And you can see how many people it is.
sentences.zh: (掌声) 你可以看到有多少人。

sentences.en: It's about 25,000 people. And the media asked, "Amanda, the music business is tanking and you encourage piracy.
sentences.zh: 媒体问道,“Amanda,音乐业正在兴起,你鼓励海盗活动。

sentences.en: How did you make all these people pay for music?"
sentences.zh: 你是怎么让这些人为音乐付出代价的?"

sentences.en: And the real answer is, I didn't make them.
sentences.zh: 真正的答案是 我没有做

sentences.en: I asked them. And through the very act of asking people, I'd connected with them, and when you connect with them, people want to help you.
sentences.zh: 我问了他们。通过询问人们的行为, 我与他们有联系, 当你与他们有联系, 人们想帮助你。

sentences.en: It's kind of counterintuitive for a lot of artists.
sentences.zh: 这对很多艺术家来说都是反直觉的

sentences.en: They don't want to ask for things. But it's not easy.
sentences.zh: 他们不想要东西,但不容易

sentences.en: It's not easy to ask. And a lot of artists have a problem with this.
sentences.zh: 问起来不容易 很多艺术家对此有异议

sentences.en: Asking makes you vulnerable. And I got a lot of criticism online, after my Kickstarter went big, for continuing my crazy crowdsourcing practices, specifically for asking musicians
sentences.zh: 问问题让你很脆弱。我在网上有很多批评, 在我的踢踏板大赛后, 继续我疯狂的众包做法, 特别是问音乐家

sentences.en: who are fans if they wanted to join us on stage for a few songs in exchange for love and tickets and beer, and this was a doctored image that went up of me on a website.
sentences.zh: 他们是粉丝,如果他们想加入我们 在舞台上的一些歌曲 换取爱 和票和啤酒,

sentences.en: And this hurt in a really familiar way. And people saying, "You're not allowed anymore to ask for that kind of help," really reminded me of the people in their cars yelling, "Get a job."
sentences.zh: 这伤害了人们熟悉的方式。人们说,“你不能再要求这种帮助了,” 确实让我想起在他们车里的人喊着“找份工作”。

sentences.en: Because they weren't with us on the sidewalk, and they couldn't see the exchange that was happening between me and my crowd, an exchange that was very fair to us but alien to them.
sentences.zh: 因为他们不在人行道上, 他们看不到我和人群之间的交流, 这种交流对我们非常公平,但对他们而言是陌生的。

sentences.en: So this is slightly not safe for work. This is my Kickstarter backer party in Berlin.
sentences.zh: 这对工作有点不安全,这是我在柏林的踢踏队后台派对

sentences.en: At the end of the night, I stripped and let everyone draw on me.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上,我剥光了衣服,让每个人都画我

sentences.en: Now let me tell you, if you want to experience the visceral feeling of trusting strangers -- (Laughter) I recommend this, especially if those strangers are drunk German people.
sentences.zh: 现在让我告诉你,如果你想体验 信任陌生人的内心感觉-- (笑声) 我建议这样做,特别是如果那些陌生人是醉酒的德国人。

sentences.en: (Laughter) This was a ninja master-level fan connection, because what I was really saying here was, I trust you this much.
sentences.zh: 这是忍者大师级的粉丝联系, 因为我真正说的是, 我信任你这么多。

sentences.en: Should I? Show me. For most of human history, musicians, artists, they've been part of the community.
sentences.zh: 证明给我看 人类历史上 音乐家 艺术家 他们一直是社会的一部分

sentences.en: Connectors and openers, not untouchable stars.
sentences.zh: 连接器和开口器 不是不可触碰的恒星

sentences.en: Celebrity is about a lot of people loving you from a distance, but the Internet and the content that we're freely able to share on it are taking us back.
sentences.zh: 名人是很多人 从远处爱你, 但互联网 和内容,我们可以自由分享 它正在带我们回来。

sentences.en: It's about a few people loving you up close and about those people being enough.
sentences.zh: 是关于几个人亲近地爱着你 也是为了那些人够多的

sentences.en: So a lot of people are confused by the idea of no hard sticker price.
sentences.zh: 所以很多人被没有硬贴纸价格的想法弄糊涂了。

sentences.en: They see it as an unpredictable risk, but the things I've done, the Kickstarter, the street, the doorbell, I don't see these things as risk.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是一个无法预测的风险, 但我做过的事情,踢踏机, 街道,门铃, 我不认为这些东西是风险。

sentences.en: I see them as trust. Now, the online tools to make the exchange as easy and as instinctive as the street, they're getting there.
sentences.zh: 我把他们看成是信任。现在,在线工具 使交换变得简单和本能 街道,他们正在到达那里。

sentences.en: But the perfect tools aren't going to help us if we can't face each other and give and receive fearlessly, but, more important -- to ask without shame.
sentences.zh: 但是如果我们不能面对对方 毫不畏惧地给予和接受 完美的工具是不会帮助我们的 但是 更重要的是 毫不羞耻地问

sentences.en: My music career has been spent trying to encounter people on the Internet the way I could on the box.
sentences.zh: 我的音乐事业花在了 尝试在互联网上遇到人们 就像我在盒子上那样

sentences.en: So blogging and tweeting not just about my tour dates and my new video but about our work and our art and our fears and our hangovers, our mistakes, and we see each other.
sentences.zh: 博客和推特不仅涉及我的旅游日期和新视频, 也涉及我们的工作、艺术、恐惧、宿醉、错误,

sentences.en: And I think when we really see each other, we want to help each other.
sentences.zh: 我想当我们真的见面的时候, 我们想互相帮助。

sentences.en: I think people have been obsessed with the wrong question, which is, "How do we make people pay for music?"
sentences.zh: 我想人们对一个错误的问题很着迷, 那就是,“我们如何让人们为音乐付出代价?”

sentences.en: What if we started asking, "How do we let people pay for music?"
sentences.zh: 如果我们开始问,“我们如何让人们为音乐付出代价?”

sentences.en: Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢。 （掌声）
